{{Quote|Left for dead by the Rebels after the Emperor's shuttle was attacked, he followed our enemies to their fortress. Though he was too late to save Palpatine, he overheard the Emperor's physician being interrogated by the Rebels&hellip;|Kir Kanos, speaking about the Guardsman|<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />}}
A '''member of the Emperor's Royal Guard''' served the [[Essence transfer|reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Empire]]. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Guardsman]] accompanied the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during an [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|attempted abduction]] of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] infant [[Anakin Solo]] and remained stationed at the Emperor's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. When the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] came under attack by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] allies, the Guardsman engaged the young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Rayf Ysanna]] in one-on-one combat but lost. Wounded, he made his way to the [[Kira Fortress]], where Palpatine had ventured to kidnap the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] child.

Yet, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Guardsman arrived at the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], the Emperor had already been [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Instead, the Guardsman witnessed the New Republic's interrogation of the captive [[Emperor's physician]], who admitted his involvement in a conspiracy against the Emperor on behalf of Guardsman [[Carnor Jax]] that had been instrumental in Palpatine's ultimate demise. The Guardsman escaped from Onderon and traveled to the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] on the planet [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], where he revealed what he knew to fellow Royal Guards gathered there. A [[Attack on the Imperial Royal Guard Academy|surprise attack]] by Jax's forces followed, resulting in the death of the Guardsman and nearly all of his kin, with the exception of one, [[Kir Kanos]], who swore vengeance on all traitors to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==Biography==
===Arrival at Onderon===
{{Quote|He was one of the chosen who had been on Onderon with the Emperor.|Kir Kanos|<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Fact File" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual served the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Empire|incarnation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was a member of the elite [[Corps/Legends|corps]] known as the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" /> In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Guardsman accompanied the ailing clone of Palpatine to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] aboard the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Eclipse II]]''.<ref name="Empire's End">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

The Emperor, who inhabited his final clone body and had no other vessel to which he could [[Essence transfer|transfer]] his spirit,<ref name="EE 1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref> hoped to use the [[Reproduction/Legends|newborn]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] son of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], as his new vessel. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] were taking shelter with the [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Modon Kira (Galactic Civil War)|Modon Kira]] at the [[Iziz ruling family|Royal]] [[Kira Fortress]], so the Emperor decided to follow them there. Palpatine boarded a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], accompanied by his [[Emperor's physician|personal physician]], two [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]], and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. To round out the entourage, the Guardsman was chosen to accompany his master, along with one other member of the Royal Guard.<ref name="Empire's End" />

===Battle at the spaceport===
{{Quote|We had trusted to the skills of Skywalker and his Jedi to dispatch the two members of the Imperial Guard who were with the Emperor on Onderon&mdash;but even there our plans went awry. The inexperienced young Jedi merely ''wounded'' the Guardsman he fought.|Carnor Jax|<ref name="Crimson Empire 0">[[Crimson Empire 0|''Crimson Empire'' 0]]</ref>}}
[[File:Rayf_wounds_Guard.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The Guardsman was wounded by Rayf Ysanna but ultimately survived.]]
After the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] landed at the [[Iziz Starport|spaceport]] in<ref name="Empire's End" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Onderon SWE">{{SWE|locations|onderon|Onderon}}</ref> of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the Emperor left on [[Limb/Legends|foot]] toward the Kira [[Fortress/Legends|Fortress]], accompanied only by his [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] and the [[darksider]] [[T'iaz]], while the Guardsman and the rest of the Emperor's entourage were left behind at the shuttle to create a ruse of the Emperor still being aboard. Soon enough, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] reinforcements, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], arrived on Onderon to apprehend the Emperor. Believing that Palpatine was still aboard the shuttle, they [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|assaulted]] the Imperial forces.<ref name="Empire's End" />

The Guardsman and his comrade engaged Skywalker and his young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Rayf Ysanna]].<ref name="Empire's End" /> The other Guard was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Skywalker, but the Guardsman who fought [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] was merely wounded by the young Jedi, who mistakenly believed that he had killed the Guard and so left him.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" /> After the Jedi learned that the Emperor was not aboard the shuttle, they immediately left for the fortress to confront Palpatine and assist Organa Solo.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Having regained consciousness, the Guardsman also made his way to the fortress, hoping to assist his master, but he was too late, as the Emperor had been killed. Of the two companions who had accompanied the Emperor to the fortress, T'iaz had been slain as well, but the Emperor's physician had been taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by Skywalker and his allies. From a hiding spot, the Guardsman listened in as Skywalker and his brother-in-law, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], interrogated the doctor.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

===Learning the truth===
{{Quote|The ''weakest'' of the Emperor's contingent, the ''physician'', should have been the first to die. But Skywalker and his kin failed to act as we anticipated. Instead, they spared his life so that he might tell them the story of his treachery. ''Worse'', his confession was overheard by one of the Emperor's Guards!|Carnor Jax|<ref name="Crimson Empire 0" />}}
Much to his shock, the Guardsman heard the physician's confession&mdash;the man had been bribed by the Royal Guardsman [[Carnor Jax]] and members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council]] to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] Palpatine's supply of clones, causing them to deteriorate quickly, and also to taint the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] samples to ensure that a new supply of stable clones could not be produced. Having learned of such treachery from Jax, one of his own kind, the Guardsman was able to slip away from the fortress and leave Onderon. Pursued by Imperial forces loyal to Jax, the Guardsman was determined to reveal the truth to his brothers-in-arms.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

[[File:Guard_returns_to_Yinchorr.jpg|thumb|left|275px|The Guardsman reveals Carnor Jax's treachery to his brothers-in-arms on Yinchorr.]]
Ten [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the Emperor's death, the man arrived at the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] on the planet [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], where the surviving members of the Royal Guard had gathered to mourn Palpatine's passing. The bruised and battered Guardsman revealed his knowledge of Jax's treachery to the others, causing all present to swear revenge on the traitors. However, at that very moment, the training center was [[Attack on the Imperial Royal Guard Academy|assaulted]] by Jax's [[Crimson Empire|loyalist]] stormtroopers. The Royal Guard put up a valiant fight, but nearly all of them, including the survivor of Onderon, were slaughtered by the enemy. The only survivor who was able to escape was a man named [[Kir Kanos]],<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" /> who ultimately avenged his betrayed brothers.<ref name="Crimson Empire 6">[[Crimson Empire 6|''Crimson Empire'' 6]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|On the tenth day of our mourning, another one of our brothers joined us. He had made his way to Yinchorr at great peril to his life.|Kir Kanos|<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />}}
The Guardsman was fiercely loyal to his liege, Galactic Emperor Palpatine. Despite being wounded in battle with the young Jedi novice Rayf Ysanna, his first instinct was to come to Palpatine's aid. After learning of the physician's treachery, he made it his personal mission to inform his fellow members of the Royal Guard of what he had heard at the Kira Fortress. The Guardsman risked his own life to evade Carnor Jax's agents and managed to reach Yinchorr with his knowledge.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Further, your own troops failed to prevent the Guardsman from making his way back to Yinchorr&mdash;|Carnor Jax berates [[General/Legends|General]] [[Redd Wessel]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire 0" />}}
[[File:Guardsman_fights_back.jpg|thumb|right|275px|The Guardsman fights for his life while trying to reach Yinchorr.]]
A member of the elite Royal Guard, the individual was one of the two Guardsmen chosen to accompany Palpatine in his final mission to Onderon. Despite his skills, the Guardsman was outmatched by the Jedi trainee Rayf Ysanna in a duel. However, he later displayed great skill in fighting the forces that hunted him after his escape from Onderon.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

==Equipment==
The individual wore the standard [[Color/Legends|crimson]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the Emperor's Royal Guard. Around the time of his death, he wielded a [[double vibroblade]] and also made use of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Kile Hannad! We thought you died on Onderon.''"<br />"''I survived&hellip;barely. I was unable to save our Emperor from the Rebels.|The Guardsman, "Kile Hannad," rejoins his kin in the ''Crimson Empire'' audio drama|audio=WeThoughtYouDiedOnOnderon.flac|<ref name="CE audio" />}}
The Royal Guardsman first appeared in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]], written by [[Tom Veitch]] and illustrated by [[Jim Baikie]]. The comic depicted him and another Royal Guard in a single panel, engaged in battle with Luke Skywalker and Rayf Ysanna.<ref name="Empire's End" /> The follow-up [[1997]]&ndash;[[1998]] series ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]'', written by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]] and illustrated by [[Paul Gulacy]], established a backstory for one of those Guardsmen, portraying his escape from Onderon with crucial information about Carnor Jax's betrayal.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" />

The [[1999]] [[Crimson Empire (audio drama)|audio dramatization of ''Crimson Empire'']] combined this Guardsman's story with that of [[Kile Hannad]], another Guardsman from the comic-book version of the story. During the stormtrooper attack on Yinchorr, Hannad and Kir Kanos are the last two Guardsmen left standing, and Hannad sacrifices his life to allow Kanos to escape.<ref name="CE audio">[[Crimson Empire (audio drama)|''Crimson Empire'' audio drama]]</ref> However, the original comic-book version portrays Hannad as a separate character and shows that the survivor of Onderon has already been killed by the stormtroopers before Hannad makes his own last stand.<ref name="Crimson Empire 3" /> This article assumes the comic's depiction of events to be correct.
